tldr: Mars in the 6th house: drive, energy, and assertion push into work, health, and routine
body: Mars in the 6th house: drive, energy, and assertion push into work, health, and routine. Gift: real force there. Watch: friction and impatience. With Mars in the 6th house, drive, assertion, desire, conflict, courage, heat, and the ability to act move through daily work, health, habits, service, maintenance, and labor. This makes how your days are built and whether your routine supports the life you say you want a central part of the life. Used consciously, this placement can become initiative, courage, stamina, directness, and the power to move this area forward. Left unconscious, it can become impatience, defensiveness, conflict for its own sake, or burning through this area faster than it can stabilize.
gift: initiative, courage, stamina, directness, and the power to move this area forward expressed through rhythm and service.
challenge: impatience, defensiveness, conflict for its own sake, or burning through this area faster than it can stabilize concentrated in rhythm and service.
note: Merged with approved project planet-through-house material; source file was not copied into the repository.
